// diagnostic E0908

Jet.DuplicateTraitImpl

Duplicate trait impl

What

Duplicate trait impl

Why

A type implements each trait once, so every call has one method to reach

Fix

Remove the duplicate trait implementation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.DuplicateTraitImpl: Tests/UI/codec_impl_concrete_argument_refused.stderr.

Error: Jet.DuplicateTraitImpl: `impl Many<Small>.Name` singles out one instance of `Many`
  --> Tests/UI/codec_impl_concrete_argument_refused.jet:15:11
    |
 15 | impl Many<Small>.Name {
    |           ^^^^^
 Why: Impls may not overlap, so an impl of `Name` covers every `Many` whose parameters meet its bounds and never names a type argument such as `<Small>`
 Fix: Implement `Name` once for every `Many`, with bounds on its parameters, and move what differs for `Small` into impls on those types
